report: The lineup is already set, so there are no start/sit changes. No starter is injured or on a bye. You are 2-7 after losing 83.9 to 128.8 last week, and your starters are scoring below their season averages (Stafford 13.1 over the last 3 against 16.3 for the season, Javonte Williams 12.3 against 16.7, LaPorta 5.4 against 10.6). Ladd McConkey, Omar Cooper Jr. and Pierre Strong Jr. are all Out, so your bench is thinner than it looks. The biggest upgrade available is QB: Josh Allen averages 24.8 with a floor of 18.0, against Stafford at 16.3 and a floor of 9.4. Send that trade first, then the Pickens, Kittle and Burden offers. Several offers use the same bench pieces (Flournoy, Tank Dell), so send them in rank order and pull any overlapping ones once a trade is accepted.

team_breakdown.note: Stafford averages 16.3 with a 9.4 floor and has trended down to 13.1 over his last 3. That is a low floor for a QB, though ARI ranks 2nd in points allowed to QBs.
Javonte Williams (16.7, 20 carries a game) is solid, but Rachaad White (9.7) and Stevenson (11.5, floor 3.6) are thin, and the bench RBs are Black (5.8) and McGowan (4.6).
Higgins (19.0, 23.1 over his last 3) is a true WR1 and McMillan (14.6) is steady. J. Williams (12.7) is a good flex against NE, which ranks 2nd in points allowed to WRs.
LaPorta averages 10.6 but has fallen to 5.4 over his last 3, even with 90% of the snaps. DET meets NE, which ranks 29th against TEs, so this week's matchup is good.
Flournoy is healthy at 10.3 (13.2 over his last 3). Tank Dell is at 10.4 but played only 3 games.
McConkey, Cooper and Strong are all Out. Only Flournoy, Dell, Black and McGowan can actually play this week.

plan: Upgrade QB with Josh Allen or Cousins to raise the floor from 9.4 to 14-18.
Use the Flournoy and Dell bench depth to land a WR or TE starter (Pickens, Kittle or Burden).
Use the waiver pickups to replace the Out players on the bench.

trades.why: Josh Allen averages 24.8 with a floor of 18.0 and a ceiling of 32.6, against Stafford at 16.3 with a floor of 9.4, so this is MORE POINTS and a much steadier QB. daddyisback8 is 1-8 and starts Virgil (2.8) and Fields (7.0) at WR, so Flournoy (10.3) and Dell (10.4) both start for them. Stafford (16.3) also beats their backup Penix (13.6), so they keep a solid QB.

trades.fallback: Add Dell back in; walk away if they want McMillan
